name: unpack_three_plane_rows
description: Reads pixel bytes from a source stream and a zero-terminated list of row counts, then writes each byte into three bitplane areas combined with OR, OR and XOR. It is a row-by-row bitplane unpacker.

name: stub_return_only
description: This entry contains only a return and does nothing. It is an empty stub that one unnamed routine refers to.

name: update_visible_terrain_grid
description: Compares the viewer's current cell with the cached one. When the cell changed, it stores the new cell and reads three bitplanes of terrain bits for the surrounding 15 by 15 cells; in both cases it then projects those cells to screen values using lookup tables and a clamped range.

name: update_visible_terrain_grid
description: Compares the viewer's current cell with the cached one. When the cell changed, it stores the new cell and reads three bitplanes of terrain bits for the surrounding 15 by 15 cells; in both cases it then projects those cells to screen values using lookup tables and a clamped range.

name: update_visible_terrain_grid
description: Compares the viewer's current cell with the cached one. When the cell changed, it stores the new cell and reads three bitplanes of terrain bits for the surrounding 15 by 15 cells; in both cases it then projects those cells to screen values using lookup tables and a clamped range.

name: read_terrain_bits_into_grid
description: Performs the same cell check and projection setup as its neighbouring grid routines, then reads one bit from each of three bitplanes per cell and stores a 0 or 100 value for it. It sets a flag at the centre cell when the second plane is set and the third is clear.

name: compute_grid_cell_screen_values
description: Projects a 15 by 15 grid of cells to screen values using cached per-cell values and lookup tables, clamping the results to a fixed range and marking cells outside it as hidden. It then stores a continuation pointer and two parameter words in the object record.

name: compute_grid_cell_screen_values
description: Projects a 15 by 15 grid of cells to screen values using cached per-cell values and lookup tables, clamping the results to a fixed range and marking cells outside it as hidden. It then stores a continuation pointer and two parameter words in the object record.

name: advance_or_fill_grid_columns
description: Calls three unnamed routines, then either fills vertical strips of screen memory for cells with non-negative values when a step counter equals 8, or advances a pointer through the grid data, lowers the counter by four and returns the absolute value of the entry it read.

name: flood_fill_grid_cells
description: Marks a grid cell as visited, then recurses into neighbouring cells that are still unmarked, using a table of neighbour offsets. It walks a list of such offsets, so it performs a flood fill over the cell grid.

name: draw_sorted_triangle_edges
description: Sorts three vertex coordinates and works out the step direction and increments for the edges between them, calling unnamed routines for each span. The column index is clamped to a 40-entry row width.

name: step_line_pixels_with_error
description: Walks a line from a start point using error accumulators on both axes, calling an unnamed routine for each step until it reaches a negative terminator in the point list. Separate branches handle each direction of travel.

name: fill_column_or_lower_top
description: Clamps a vertical span to a fixed range, then either fills that column of screen memory row by row, 40 bytes apart, when a flag is clear, or lowers the stored top value for the column when the flag is set.

name: build_row_offset_table
description: Builds a table of 200 screen-row byte offsets in steps of 40 bytes, clears the work arrays and a list of records, then disables and re-enables the vertical blank interrupt through the interrupt enable register.

name: poll_buttons_and_advance_frame
description: Advances the frame counter, reads the fire and right buttons from the controller port registers into a button-state word, and steps a phase counter when that state changes. It then places two sprite entries and scans a list of records for an overlap with the current one.

name: advance_frame_and_test_overlap
description: Steps the frame state and places two sprite entries as in the neighbouring routine. In the branch used when the timer state is set, it walks a linked list of records testing whether each record's box covers the object's position, and copies the matching record's values into the object.

name: finish_frame_after_table_store
description: Stores a value from a lookup table into the object record and negates the stored value for one table index. It then runs the closing part of the frame update, advancing the phase counter and repositioning the object when the timer state is set.

name: store_entry_and_close_frame
description: Stores a lookup-table value into the object record and negates it for one table index. It then runs the closing frame update, which advances the phase counter and repositions the object when the timer state is set.

name: find_overlap_record_and_step
description: Walks a list of records until it finds one whose box covers the given point, then updates that record's phase and value from a lookup table. It then finishes the frame update, advancing the phase counter and repositioning the object when the timer state is set.

name: scan_records_and_restore_state
description: When the state flag and position test pass, it saves four long words of the object and sets new values, then walks a list of records until one covers the object's position. It restores the saved words afterwards and stores a table value into the object.

name: load_long_pair_from_table
description: Scales an index from the record by eight, reads two long words from a table held in the object, and stores them in the object's work fields. It then calls an unnamed routine to finish.

name: blit_masked_sprite_rows
description: Blits sixteen rows of a sprite through a mask. It clears the destination planes under the mask, then shifts four source words per row by a count and combines them with the mask into two sets of four bitplanes.

name: load_object_sprite_entries
description: Reads an object's setup block and copies its position and attribute fields into the object record. It then loops over a list of sprite entries, filling each record with computed plane offsets, image pointers taken from tables and zeroed animation fields, until a negative terminator.

name: load_object_sprite_entries
description: Reads an object's setup block and copies its position and attribute fields into the object record. It then loops over a list of sprite entries, filling each record with computed plane offsets, image pointers taken from tables and zeroed animation fields, until a negative terminator.

name: load_object_sprite_entries
description: Reads an object's setup block and copies its position and attribute fields into the object record. It then loops over a list of sprite entries, filling each record with computed plane offsets, image pointers taken from tables and zeroed animation fields, until a negative terminator.

name: load_object_sprite_entries
description: Reads an object's setup block and copies its position and attribute fields into the object record. It then loops over a list of sprite entries, filling each record with computed plane offsets, image pointers taken from tables and zeroed animation fields, until a negative terminator.

name: set_empty_fields_to_value
description: Walks sixteen 96-byte records and writes a supplied value into the field at offset 8 of each record whose field is still zero.

name: search_flagged_record_list
description: Walks a list of records linked by relative offsets, testing each record's mask word against the search masks and the flag word. It stops at the first match and stores the matching position and a status word in the object.

name: search_record_list_by_mask
description: Walks a list of records linked by two-byte relative offsets and tests each record's mask word against the search masks. It stops at the first match and stores the matching position and a status word in the object.

name: search_record_list_by_mask
description: Walks a list of records linked by four-byte relative offsets and tests each record's mask word against the search masks. It stops at the first match and stores the matching position and a status word in the object.

name: draw_object_with_blitter
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then programs its masks, minterm control, modulos and source and destination pointers from the object's position. It starts a small rectangle copy and returns.

name: start_blitter_from_object_pointers
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, sets its masks and minterm control, then loads source and destination pointers from two fields of the object and starts a small rectangle copy.

name: emit_sprite_strip_entries
description: Checks that an x position lies in the visible range, derives a control word and column selection from it, then writes sprite-style control words for a vertical strip into a list held by the object. It returns early when the position falls outside the clipped area.

name: emit_sprite_strip_entries
description: Checks that an x position lies in the visible range, derives a control word and column selection from it, then writes sprite-style control words for a vertical strip into a list held by the object. It returns early when the position falls outside the clipped area.

name: emit_sprite_strip_entries
description: Checks that an x position lies in the visible range, derives a control word and column selection from it, then writes sprite-style control words for a vertical strip into a list held by the object. It returns early when the position falls outside the clipped area.

name: emit_sprite_strip_entries
description: Checks that an x position lies in the visible range, derives a control word and column selection from it, then writes sprite-style control words for a vertical strip into a list held by the object. It returns early when the position falls outside the clipped area.

name: emit_sprite_strip_entries
description: Checks that an x position lies in the visible range, derives a control word and column selection from it, then writes sprite-style control words for a vertical strip into a list held by the object. It returns early when the position falls outside the clipped area.

name: emit_sprite_strip_and_blit
description: Runs the same column-entry setup as its neighbours and then, for the visible strip, waits for the blitter and programs it to copy the strip's source and mask planes. It briefly changes the interrupt enable register around the blit.

name: write_three_plane_blit_entries
description: Runs three times, each time writing a full-mask copy entry for one bitplane: masks, minterm control, source and destination pointers taken from the caller and the object, and a row word. It advances the plane pointer by one plane size between passes.

name: write_offset_plane_blit_entries
description: Chooses a row from an object value, defaulting it when negative, and sets the start address and a constant. It then writes three full-mask plane entries as its neighbours do, stepping the plane pointer by one plane size each time.

name: write_three_plane_blit_entries
description: Runs three times, each time writing a full-mask copy entry for one bitplane: masks, minterm control, source and destination pointers taken from the caller and the object, and a row word. It advances the plane pointer by one plane size between passes.

name: write_pair_plane_blit_entries
description: Writes one entry at a fixed start position, then writes three full-mask plane entries at a second position computed from the object's offset. It advances the plane pointer by one plane size between passes.

name: write_height_plane_blit_entries
description: Derives two start positions from an object field, writes one entry at the first, then writes three full-mask plane entries at the second. Row values are computed from the object's height field.

name: write_three_plane_blit_entries
description: Runs three times, each time writing a full-mask copy entry for one bitplane: masks, minterm control, source and destination pointers taken from the caller and the object, and a row word. It advances the plane pointer by one plane size between passes. The caller first waits until the blitter is idle.

name: write_offset_indexed_plane_bytes
description: Walks rows and columns over a table of offsets, writing a computed byte into each of several plane buffers at the offset the table gives. Each row is handled in alternating passes across the buffers, and unnamed routine calls supply the byte value.

name: stub_empty_decompile_body
description: The decompiler produced only an empty body for this 324-instruction routine, so no behaviour can be recovered from the pseudo-code. It is recorded as a stub for that reason.

name: refresh_plane_buffers_with_mask
description: Copies four bitplane rows from the object into working buffers, fills the edge rows with solid words and inverted mask words, then swaps two buffer pointers in the object.

name: swap_buffers_and_wait_flag
description: Swaps the two buffer pointers held in the object, sets a ready flag, waits until a hardware status bit becomes set, and then re-enables that interrupt bit.

name: copy_working_buffers_to_planes
description: Copies a block of long words from four working buffers back into the object's four bitplanes, row run by row run.

name: write_checkerboard_mask_rows
description: Clears ten long-word fields of the object, sets one byte per row in a scroll buffer from a table, and then writes alternating checkerboard bit patterns across the rows, combined with a stored mask.

name: compute_viewport_clip_rect
description: Chooses one of two view layouts from a mode flag, offsets the object's position by that layout's constants, and clamps the result to the layout's range. It stores the clipped origin and the size of the view in the object.

name: scan_records_for_closest_hit
description: Walks a list of object records and, for each one that overlaps the search point, compares a scaled distance value against the best found so far. It stores the record it chose and a status word when the loop ends.

name: turn_heading_toward_target
description: Chooses a target heading from the record or the object's table, then turns the record's stored heading toward it by a rate-limited step, wrapping around a full circle. It stores the new heading and then the target position.

name: apply_scaled_velocity_components
description: Scales two table values by an input factor, divides them by a power of two taken from a global table, and adds the results to the record's two position fields. It keeps a byte of the fractional remainder for each axis.

name: compute_cordic_angle_from_deltas
description: Runs a sixteen-step CORDIC-style iteration on the difference between the input point and the record's position, using step constants from a global table. It returns a fixed-point value built from the accumulated components.

name: compute_cordic_angle_from_deltas
description: Runs a sixteen-step CORDIC-style iteration on the difference between the input point and the record's position, using step constants from a global table. It returns a fixed-point value built from the accumulated components.

name: compute_cordic_angle_from_deltas
description: Runs a sixteen-step CORDIC-style iteration on the difference between the input point and the record's position, using step constants from a global table. It returns a fixed-point value built from the accumulated components.

name: combine_span_masks_into_planes
description: Clears a block of mask bytes, then for each span in a list reads a table offset, combines it with a bit mask, and ORs the looked-up plane words into the block. It stops at a negative end-of-list marker.

name: accumulate_span_plane_masks
description: For each row it clears the mask state, then ORs plane words selected through a table, combined with per-span masks, into the accumulated state. It loops until a negative end-of-list marker.

name: build_edge_span_table
description: Builds a per-row table of span entries for a line between two points, stepping with a fixed-point accumulator in the style of a digital differential analyser. It writes the entries into a list held by the object and ends the list with a negative marker.

name: update_target_index_state
description: Returns the current target index with a status code. It returns the new index when it differs from the last one stored, and otherwise a code derived from the object's flags and the stored state.

name: reset_target_index_state
description: Clears the stored state words, then returns the current target index with a status code by following the same checks as its sibling routine.

name: read_target_index_status
description: Returns the input value when a block flag or stored state is set. Otherwise it derives a status code from the target record's type and from the state tables held in the globals.

name: read_target_status_direct
description: Reads the status of the current target without the block-flag check, returning zero for an empty target and otherwise deriving a code from the record's type and the global state tables.

name: walk_target_state_table
description: Looks up the target's kind from its record and walks the matching table of entries, copying each entry's values into the global control words until a sentinel is reached.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return and does nothing, so it is an empty stub called by one unnamed routine.

name: begin_target_transition_state
description: When the target is valid and no transition is active, it searches a small table for the first entry not equal to six, copies that entry to a control word, and marks a transition as started. It then stores new pointers for the next stage.

name: begin_target_transition_indexed
description: Uses the table entry selected by the index passed in, and otherwise follows its sibling: when a transition is due and not already active, it copies the first table entry not equal to six and marks the transition as started.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return and does nothing, so it is an empty stub called by two unnamed routines.

name: reset_transition_phase
description: Clears the transition phase word in the object and returns. It is the reset step used before a new transition begins.

name: append_timed_event_entry
description: Finds the first free entry in a 32-entry table of timed events and fills it with a pointer, a value taken from the source list and a counter. It stops early when the source list is exhausted.

name: run_event_phase_state_machine
description: Advances a small phase state machine over queued events. It finds the first ready event, runs one step per frame in the active phase, and when a phase completes it clears a block of words in the screen buffer before resetting.

name: draw_text_string_to_planes
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into the four bitplanes, one eight-row glyph per character. A space clears the glyph area, and any other character is taken from a font table and combined with a background word before being written to each plane.

name: format_number_as_decimal_digits
description: Converts a value into decimal digits by repeated subtraction of powers of ten taken from a table, writing ASCII digits into a buffer and a minus sign for negative entries. It then updates a countdown held in the object.

name: format_number_as_decimal_digits
description: Converts a value into decimal digits by repeated subtraction of powers of ten taken from a table, writing ASCII digits into a buffer and a minus sign for negative entries. It then updates a countdown held in the object.

name: draw_text_string_to_planes
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into the four bitplanes, one eight-row glyph per character. A space clears the glyph area, and other characters are taken from a font table and combined with a background word. In the other display mode it first adjusts each character code.

name: tick_countdown_and_spawn_record
description: Lowers a countdown by a power-of-two step, and when it drops below a threshold it resets the threshold and starts a new record at the object's base. It then flips the sign of the first negative entry in a list of eight values.

name: tick_countdown_and_spawn_record
description: Lowers a countdown by a power-of-two step, and when it drops below a threshold it resets the threshold and starts a new record at the object's base. It then flips the sign of the first negative entry in a list of eight values.

name: advance_record_chain_until_clear
description: Negates the entry before the current position in a list of eight values, then advances through a linked chain of records until one has its end flag clear. It restores the saved object words afterwards.

name: advance_record_chain_until_clear
description: Negates the entry before the current position in a list of eight values, then advances through a linked chain of records until one has its end flag clear. It restores the saved object words afterwards.

name: restore_record_state_words
description: Stores three parameter words and one stacked value back into the object's state fields at fixed offsets and then returns. It is the restore step used at the end of a chain walk.

name: stub_empty_decompile_body
description: The decompiler produced only an empty body for this routine, so no behaviour can be recovered from the pseudo-code. It is recorded as a stub for that reason.

name: stub_empty_decompile_body
description: The decompiler produced only an empty body for this routine, so no behaviour can be recovered from the pseudo-code. It is recorded as a stub for that reason.

name: lay_out_text_lines
description: Copies a block of 25 records into a text buffer, then scans it line by line, ending each line at a carriage-return or terminator character.

name: copy_background_image_to_planes
description: When the setup flag is set and the state word is clear, copies a four-plane background image from the object's image buffer into the bitplanes. It then resets the object's state values for the new screen.

name: add_table_digits_to_string
description: Adds a table of eight digits to an eight-character ASCII decimal string with carry, writing each result back as a digit.

name: subtract_table_digits_from_string
description: Subtracts a table of eight digits from an eight-character ASCII decimal string with borrow, writing each result back as a digit.

name: expand_packed_image_to_planes
description: Expands a packed image from a source stream into four bitplanes, reading interleaved source bytes into each pixel group and optionally inverting the bits. The referenced strings name rank and result picture files, which is where this image is drawn.

name: wait_for_button_combination
description: Waits until the fire and right button bits from the controller registers are both set, then returns as soon as either one is released.

name: place_record_marker_on_screen
description: Advances a frame counter, then for each record in a list converts its world position to a cell through a sine-style table and divides by the cell size. It places the marker into the plane buffers at that cell.

name: select_record_and_clear_buffer
description: When the current record matches the object's position, it marks the state active and fills a 180-byte buffer with ones. It then swaps the stored target index with the record's index when the match flag is set.

name: claim_free_record_slot
description: When the record at the given position is unclaimed, it saves the current search state, scans records for the matching index, and claims the slot by copying the caller's position and attributes into it. It then restores the search state and walks forward to the next record.

name: scan_record_chain_for_index
description: Walks a chain of records, subtracting a stored step from the index at each hop until the index reaches zero. It then calls an unnamed routine once and sets a found flag, or clears the flag and returns when the chain runs out.

name: draw_marker_rows_with_blitter
description: Chooses a horizontal offset from a table using the record's count value, then writes blitter-style register values for three rows of masked copies at that position.

name: find_record_under_point
description: Checks the record's flags and, when no special flag is set, walks a list of records looking for one whose position lies within a 150-unit box around the object. It returns the matching record's value, or zero when none is found.

name: select_record_by_flag_bit
description: When the current record carries a special flag bit, it runs the record search and, if the search succeeds, makes the first word of the found record the new current index.

name: animate_marker_buffer_entries
description: Advances an animation counter stored in the object and, while it is active, updates each entry of a marker buffer. Unused entries get a new value derived from the frame counter, and used entries have a pixel set in three planes at their location.

name: spawn_pending_records_from_list
description: Walks up to eight pending entries and marks each one as used. For each it initialises a new record with flags from a type table and with the entry's position and default timer.

name: update_all_record_states
description: Walks the object's record chain each frame and updates each record's state, timers and flags. A counter-driven phase sets a completion flag when it overflows, and unnamed routine calls handle the per-record steps.

name: advance_record_timers_in_chain
description: Walks a chain of records, advancing each record's small counter and setting its completion flag when the counter overflows. It also steps records through a speed-scaled phase and calls unnamed routines for each chain step.

name: resolve_pending_index_pair
description: Compares a record index with two pending index slots and clears a slot when it matches. It falls back to the current index or the saved index when the slots agree.

name: call_five_routines_in_order
description: Calls five unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no logic of its own.

name: repeat_call_until_zero
description: Calls an unnamed routine and, while it returns a non-zero value, calls a second unnamed routine and repeats. It has no other logic.

name: scan_region_list_for_point
description: Walks a list of region entries until a terminator, testing each entry's flags. Some entries are checked against the object's time or kind value, and others are tested for whether a point lies inside their bounding box.

name: advance_pseudo_random_seed
description: Multiplies a 16-bit seed by 125 and reduces it modulo 65521, then stores the new seed. This is a simple linear congruential random generator.

name: append_region_entry_from_points
description: Marks the source entry as used, then walks a list of point deltas, accumulating coordinates. It writes an entry with its bounds into the next free slot of the region list and terminates the entry with a sentinel.

name: terminate_region_entry_list
description: Writes a sentinel value into the next entry and moves the free-list pointer on by one 64-byte entry.

name: init_record_from_table_entry
description: Stores a new record pointer, then fills the record from a type table: it copies the table's image and attribute words and a block of eight words from the entry's data.

name: init_record_defaults_and_flags
description: Copies the entry's position and attribute words into the record, then sets default timer, speed and state values. Two flag bits in the entry each adjust one of the record's timer words.

name: stub_return_only
description: Returns its stacked argument unchanged and does nothing else, so it is an empty stub called by one unnamed routine.

name: start_timed_state_sequence
description: Initialises the object's state fields for a timed sequence, then runs one unnamed call and returns.

name: set_state_five_and_step
description: Sets the object's state mode to five with a fixed set of control words, runs one unnamed call, and returns.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with the result left unchanged. It has no logic of its own.

name: scan_list_for_clear_bits
description: Sets the object's state mode to five and runs an unnamed routine, then walks a list of indices until it finds one whose low two bits are clear. It returns the value from the first unnamed routine call.

name: set_state_five_and_step
description: Sets the object's state mode to five with a fixed set of control words, runs one unnamed call, and returns.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return and does nothing, so it is an empty stub.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return and does nothing, so it is an empty stub.

name: store_two_longs_in_record
description: Stores two longword values into the record's offsets 56 and 60 fields and returns. Both values come from the caller's registers.

name: increment_global_byte_counter
description: Adds one to a byte in a global array at an index passed in a data register, then returns.

name: check_objects_within_proximity
description: Walks the active object list and, for each live entry, checks whether its position lies within a threshold distance of a related entry's position using absolute differences. It calls unnamed routines for each match.

name: check_objects_within_proximity
description: Runs the same live-object walk as its neighbour, clearing a byte field on entries marked for it, and performs the proximity check on the others. It calls unnamed routines for each match.

name: update_object_targets_and_flags
description: Clears a status flag on every object entry, then for each active entry checks its kind and a global shift value, computes a distance to a related entry, and updates the entry's flags and state from the result.

name: mark_dead_and_check_range
description: Walks a counted list of entries, marking any whose kind is the excluded value or whose state byte is set as dead. For the rest it computes a distance-based check against a related entry and calls unnamed routines for each entry that passes.

name: mark_dead_and_check_range
description: Walks a counted list of entries in the same way as its neighbour, entered at a point that skips the dead-marking step. For each entry that is still live it computes a distance-based check and calls unnamed routines for the entries that pass.

name: propagate_status_bits_to_flags
description: If a status bit is set in the entry's word, copies it into the low flag bit and sets a second flag bit chosen by two other status bits.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return and does nothing, so it is an empty stub.

name: store_value_in_free_slot
description: Scans a list of one hundred entries for the first one that is negative and stores the value from the data register there. It returns without change when the list is full.

name: find_nearest_candidate_entry
description: Sets an entry's state byte from its flags, and when it is still active it scans a list of candidates for the one with the smallest distance. It stores that candidate and related fields in the entry.

name: find_nearest_candidate_entry
description: Scans a list of candidates for the one with the smallest distance, stores it in the entry and clears one flag. When there are no candidates it copies a pair of saved values and sets an active flag.

name: compute_scaled_squared_distance
description: Computes the squared distance between two points after scaling each axis difference by one thousand, returning the sum of the squared scaled differences.

name: check_range_for_kind
description: Skips entries flagged as inactive, then computes the distance between the entry and a candidate. The entry's kind code selects the range it must fall within, and when the candidate is in range the entry and a counter are adjusted.

name: mark_entry_engaged_at_time
description: Records the current time in the entry when it is in range, sets its engaged flags, and decrements a counter when the entry was newly engaged. It returns the updated flag word.

name: stub_return_only
description: Compares its input against one value and returns in both cases without changing anything, so it has no effect.

name: select_largest_priority_field
description: Scans a list of entries and picks the largest value among four priority fields, skipping entries flagged with a bit. It records which field held that value, and when one is found it calls two unnamed routines.

name: select_largest_priority_field
description: Performs the same largest-value field selection as its neighbour, starting from the list position already set by the caller.

name: find_nearest_kind_match
description: Walks a candidate list, tracking the nearest entry of one special kind by distance. For other entries that pass flag tests it calls an unnamed routine and stops at the first accepted result.

name: find_nearest_kind_match
description: Repeats the candidate walk of its neighbour, keeping the nearest entry of the special kind and stopping when a candidate passes the flag checks.

name: walk_linked_list_until_match
description: Sets the object's state words, then walks a linked list of entries. It returns once it reaches the starting entry or finds an entry whose value equals the one stored in it.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return and does nothing, so it is an empty stub.

name: walk_list_until_offset_match
description: Walks a list of entries, subtracting each entry's stored offset from the current value. It returns when the value reaches zero or when the walk comes back to its start.

name: record_event_in_free_slot
description: Finds a free slot in one of two eight-entry tables, chosen by the kind code, and stores the entry's values in it. For the special kind it also stores a scaled pair of coordinates computed from the entry's position.

name: refresh_links_and_clear_stale
description: Re-links each active entry to its target's position and clears slots whose flags show they are finished. It then walks the remaining entries to reset their links.

name: refresh_links_and_clear_stale
description: Re-links each active entry to its target's position and clears slots whose flags show they are finished. It then walks the remaining entries to reset their links.

name: relink_entries_and_clear_slots
description: Walks the entry list, clearing slots whose flags mark them finished, and resets each linked entry's position from its target. It stops at the end of the list.

name: snap_entry_to_cell_edge
description: Skips entries flagged with a bit, then compares the entry's grid cell with a neighbouring cell from a table and snaps one coordinate to the cell edge. The result is clamped to the cell bounds, using the 6000-unit cell size.

name: cell_to_world_position
description: Converts two grid cell coordinates into world positions by multiplying each by the 6000-unit cell size. The first coordinate is offset by one more cell.

name: find_nearest_cell_rectangle
description: Searches a list of rectangles for the one nearest to a point, measuring the squared distance from the point to each rectangle's edges. It stores the best rectangle and its distance.

name: find_nearest_cell_rectangle
description: Walks the same rectangle list from a different starting point and keeps the one with the smallest squared distance to the point. It returns the best position it found.

name: find_nearest_cell_rectangle
description: Walks the rectangle list again, comparing squared edge distances and keeping the nearest rectangle. It stops early when a rectangle's bounds already contain the point.

name: lookup_cell_code_from_table
description: Returns fixed codes for kinds five, six and seven and otherwise reads a code from a two-dimensional table indexed by kind and a second index.

name: read_table_word_at_index
description: Returns the word stored in a global table at the index passed in a data register.

name: update_entry_timer_if_due
description: When the entry's time falls within the current window, it runs an unnamed call and updates the entry's pointer. It then counts the entry's timer down by a fixed amount and clamps it at zero.

name: select_timed_table_entry
description: Returns early unless enough time has passed since its last run. It then picks a table pointer by the object's kind, checks the object's stored value against a table entry, and calls unnamed routines to act on a match.

name: check_point_inside_rectangle
description: Tests whether a point lies inside the rectangle given by four words at the input pointer. It produces no stored result, so it has no visible effect in this code.

name: start_table_driven_action
description: Marks the input flag, and when the object's pending count is negative it sets an active flag, calls an unnamed routine with a table-indexed address for the object's kind, and clears the pending count.

name: start_table_driven_action
description: Clears the input flag, then does the same table-driven start as its neighbour.

name: start_table_driven_action
description: Performs the table-driven start with the table address passed in by the caller.

name: start_action_without_table
description: When the object's pending count is negative, sets the active flag, runs two unnamed calls and clears the pending count.

name: load_kind_table_scale_value
description: Looks up a byte in a five-byte-per-kind table for the object's kind, doubles it, and stores the result as the current scale word.

name: scale_kind_table_value
description: Looks up a byte in the five-byte-per-kind table row for the object's kind minus two, multiplies it by a constant factor, and stores the result as the current scale word.

name: accumulate_weighted_kind_scores
description: Looks up weight bytes for the object's kind and accumulates weighted values over a list of entries, dividing each by a per-entry byte. It stores the resulting sum for later use.

name: accumulate_weighted_kind_scores
description: Performs the same weighted accumulation as its neighbour, storing a scaled result for the entry it finishes on.

name: compute_level_from_ratio
description: Divides a value by a per-entry byte and clamps the quotient to twelve. When the level is valid it stores it, increments a counter and returns the counter's value.

name: set_state_and_step
description: Sets the object's state to mode one with a fixed control word, runs one unnamed call, and returns.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with the result left unchanged. It has no logic of its own.

name: increment_tally_for_flag_bit
description: Finds the lowest set bit in a six-bit field of the entry's flags and increments the matching tally byte. The table is chosen by a region flag, and entries of one special kind use a fixed tally index.

name: increment_tally_for_flag_bit
description: Performs the same lowest-set-bit tally increment as its neighbour, on the table passed in by the caller.

name: start_music_playback_program
description: Program entry: sets up the task, initialises the music player, installs the timer interrupt, waits for playback to be ended by the player, then restores the interrupt and stops the player. It returns zero.

name: wait_until_button_released
description: Loops until either the fire button or the right button is released, reading both from the controller port registers, then returns.

name: install_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Programs the second CIA's interrupt control and timer registers with a fixed sequence of values, then points the interrupt handler at the new interrupt routine.

name: restore_original_interrupt_state
description: Writes a fixed value to the interrupt control register, restores the saved interrupt word, then writes a fixed value to the DMA control register.

name: set_current_task_priority
description: Finds the current task through the system library and sets its scheduling priority, using two library calls. It returns nothing.

name: handle_timer_interrupt_tick
description: Runs on the timer interrupt: it clears the interrupt request and then calls the music routine for the next tick. The decompiler timed out on its body, so this description rests on the listed calls and registers.

name: wait_for_raster_position
description: Reads the vertical beam position register in a wait loop. The decompiled body is an unconditional loop with no visible exit, so the exact wait condition cannot be recovered.

name: advance_song_position
description: Calls a per-voice unnamed routine four times, then resets the speed and steps the song position forward, wrapping at 128 positions. When the position reaches an end value in the song table it reloads from that table.

name: play_voice_note_event
description: Reads a four-byte note event for one voice from the current pattern and decodes its sample number. It loads the sample's start address, length, volume and period into the voice state, and a note with no sample keeps the previous sample.

name: update_voice_after_note_event
description: Updates the voice's sample position and volume, then either sustains the current note, sets a slide target for the two slide effects, or starts the new note on its channel with the sample's start address and length.

name: apply_voice_effect_command
description: Applies one voice's effect command. It sets the song position for a jump or pattern break, sets the volume for the volume command, and sets the playback speed for the speed command, clamping speed to 31 and treating zero as one.

name: set_slide_target_and_effect
description: Sets the voice's slide target from its period and resets the slide state. It then applies the same effect command handling as its sibling: jumps, pattern breaks, volume and speed.

name: clear_voice_slide_counter
description: Clears the voice's slide counter word, which stops any running slide.

name: slide_voice_period_toward_target
description: Steps a voice's period up or down by its slide speed toward a target period. It stops at the target when that is reached and stores the new period in the voice state.

name: slide_voice_period_toward_target
description: Performs the same slide step toward the target period as its sibling, stepping the voice period up or down and storing the result in the voice state.

name: slide_voice_period_down
description: Lowers a voice's period by a given amount, stopping at the target period when it is reached, and stores the period in the voice state.

name: apply_vibration_to_voice_period
description: Updates a voice's vibration speed and depth from its effect parameters, looks up a sine-table value for the current phase, and adds the scaled offset to the voice period. It then advances the vibration phase.

name: apply_vibration_to_voice_period
description: Applies the same vibration offset as its sibling using the current phase and depth, without changing the stored speed or depth.

name: set_voice_period_minus_offset
description: Stores a period value minus an offset into the voice and advances the vibration phase by the speed part of the vibration state.

name: apply_arpeggio_period
description: Selects a note offset from the effect parameter for the current speed phase, then sets the voice period to the table period that the offset reaches from the current period. Without an offset it keeps the stored period.

name: apply_arpeggio_period
description: Applies the arpeggio lookup using the low nibble of the effect parameter as the note offset, and falls back to the stored period when no table entry matches.

name: store_arpeggio_found_period
description: Stores the period found by the arpeggio search into the voice state, reading it from the table entry at the given offset.

name: restore_normal_period
description: Copies the voice's base period into its current period, cancelling any effect that changed it.

name: dispatch_voice_effect_command
description: Reads a voice's effect command nibble and dispatches to the matching effect routine: arpeggio, slides, vibrato or volume combinations. When no effect parameter is set it resets the period to its base value.

name: slide_period_up
description: Subtracts the effect parameter from the voice period, which raises the pitch, clamps the result at the lowest allowed period and stores it.

name: slide_period_down
description: Adds the effect parameter to the voice period, which lowers the pitch, clamps the result at the highest allowed period and stores it.

name: vibrato_with_volume_slide
description: Applies the vibration step, then slides the voice volume up by the upper nibble of the parameter or down by the lower nibble. The volume is clamped between zero and sixty-four and stored.

name: slide_to_note_with_volume
description: Applies the slide toward the target period, then adjusts the voice volume by the parameter's upper or lower nibble with the same clamping as its neighbour.

name: slide_voice_volume_down
description: Lowers the voice volume by the low nibble of the effect parameter, clamping it at zero, and stores the result.

name: apply_voice_effect_command
description: Applies the same effect-command handling as its sibling routines: a jump, a pattern break, a volume set or a speed set. The speed is clamped to 31 and zero is treated as one.

name: set_audio_filter_flag
description: Sets or clears the audio filter bit in the control register from bit 0 of the effect parameter, leaving the other control bits unchanged.

name: break_pattern_to_start
description: Sets the song position to one, which ends the current pattern early, and returns.

name: jump_to_song_position
description: Sets the song position to the effect parameter minus one, so playback moves to that song position after the current pattern.
